verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents ScrapingBee's HTTP API parameters, an official CLI and an official MCP server, but none of it mentions a prebuilt connector, integration or node for n8n, Zapier or any other no-code automation platform. The CLI and MCP server are different integration surfaces and do not count toward this story. A scraping API could plausibly ship such connectors, so the axis applies, and the absence of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the scraping API to no-code automation platforms like n8n or Zapier through a prebuilt connector
